DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような手続きについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What procedure would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 以前出した書類の続きについて聞きたいのですが、控えを家族の家に置いたまま引っ越しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居で家族宅に控えを置いた以前の申請を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to ask about following up on documents I submitted earlier, but I moved and left my copy at a family member's home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an earlier application whose copy you left at a family member's home when you moved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類の名前や、提出した時期を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember the document's name or when you submitted it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は正確に覚えていません。三月ごろで、子どもの利用する施設についての申請です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名称不明だが三月頃の子供施設申請と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't remember the exact name. It was around March, and the application concerned a facility my child uses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the name, but it was an application concerning a children's facility around March. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 該当する担当を確認します。ご家族から控えの内容を聞くことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check which department handles it. Can you ask your family what the copy says?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は仕事中で連絡できません。覚えていることだけで相談できる窓口を教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族と即連絡できず記憶情報で相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They're at work now, so I can't contact them. Please tell me which counter can help using only what I remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot contact your family immediately and ask where to seek advice using what you remember. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当で確認に必要な情報をご相談ください。申請者はどなたですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the department what information they need to check. Who was the applicant?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私です。家族が保管しているだけなので、家族の申請として探す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申請者は自分で家族は保管者のみと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was. My family is only keeping the copy, so there is no need to search for an application under their name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are the applicant and your family only keeps the copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申請者と保管している方は別なのですね。その点もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: So the applicant and the person keeping it are different. Please explain that as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。まず担当で不足する情報を聞きます。控えが必要なら家族に頼んで確認してから改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要情報を担当に聞き控え不足なら家族へ確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll first ask the department what information is missing. If the copy is needed, I'll ask my family to check it and then consult you again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the department what information is needed and check with your family if the missing copy is required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the department. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次回の予約についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about your next appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内を手帳に写したのですが、日付と曜日が合いません。どちらを見ればよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転記した予約日と曜日の矛盾を確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I copied the notice into my planner, but the date and day of the week don't match. I'd like to check which to follow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the discrepancy between the appointment date and weekday you copied. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の予約案内も一緒に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can we also check the original appointment notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、これです。手帳には金曜日と書きましたが、案内の日付を見ると別の曜日のようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原案内と金曜日と書いた手帳の食い違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. I wrote Friday in my planner, but the date on the notice seems to fall on another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the discrepancy between the original notice and the Friday entry in your planner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約の記録を確認します。お名前とご本人の確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the appointment record. Please give me your name and let me verify your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。変更をお願いする前に、元の予約がいつなのかを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更依頼より先に元予約日の確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Before asking to change it, I'd like to know when the original appointment is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm the original appointment date before requesting a change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後にご説明します。手帳に書いた時間は案内と同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain after checking. Is the time in your planner the same as on the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時間は同じです。日付を書き間違えた可能性があるので、自分の手帳だけで来院を決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時間は一致し手帳のみで来院を決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The time is the same. I may have copied the date incorrectly, so I won't decide when to come to the hospital based only on my planner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the times match and you will not decide when to visit the hospital using only your planner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約の確認ができたら、案内と手帳を一緒に見直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once we've confirmed the appointment, let's review the notice and your planner together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。分かった日付と曜日を読み上げて確認してから、古いメモを直します。来られない場合はその後相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認日付を復唱しメモ修正後に都合を判断すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll read the confirmed date and weekday aloud to check them before correcting my old note. If I can't come then, I'll discuss that afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will repeat the confirmed date, correct your note, and then decide whether you can attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、予約の記録を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check the appointment record now. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何か起きたことで、ご相談に来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to discuss something that happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが店の前の自転車を少し動かしてしまいました。元の位置が分からないので相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供が他人自転車を移動し原位置不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child moved a bicycle in front of a shop a little. We don't know its original position, so I came to ask for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your child moved someone else's bicycle and you do not know its original position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 自転車は今、どこにありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の横です。子どもと店の方がその近くで待っています。私は事情を伝えに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店横に自転車と子供と店員が待っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside the shop. My child and someone from the shop are waiting nearby. I came to explain what happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bicycle is beside the shop and your child and a shop employee are waiting there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのように動かしたのか、分かる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me how it was moved, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗ったのではなく押したと子どもは言っています。私は動かした瞬間を見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 押したという子供の説明と自分の未目撃を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child says they pushed it, rather than rode it. I didn't see the moment they moved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your child's account of pushing it from the fact that you did not witness it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身が確認したことと、お子さんから聞いたことを分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please separate what you have personally confirmed from what your child told you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。鍵の状態や傷は私には分かりません。元に戻せば終わりと思わず、持ち主へ事情を伝える方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵や傷は不明で所有者への説明方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I don't know about the lock or any scratches. I don't assume putting it back settles things; I'd like advice on how to explain the situation to its owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not know about the lock or scratches and ask how to explain things to the owner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応を確認します。勝手にさらに動かさず、連絡できる状態でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check what to do. Please don't move it any further on your own, and remain available to be contacted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。店へ戻ってそのことを伝えます。子どもにも、触らず待つよう話して、必要な説明に協力します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 店へ戻り再移動しないと伝え説明に協力する旨話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll return to the shop and tell them. I'll also tell my child to wait without touching it and cooperate with any explanation needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return to the shop, tell them not to move it again, and cooperate in explaining. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、こちらで確認します。お気をつけてお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check here. Please take care on your way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り状の記入についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about filling out a shipping label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達の住所は分かりますが、普段は愛称で呼んでいるので、受取人の名前をどう書くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 愛称でしか知らない友人の送り状氏名を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I know my friend's address, but I usually use their nickname, so I'm unsure what to write as the recipient's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what name to put on a shipping label for a friend you know only by a nickname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手の方に、お荷物を送ることは伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you told them you are sending a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 伝えています。住所だけ送ってもらって、名前を聞き忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送連絡済だが住所のみ受領し氏名未確認と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They sent me only their address, and I forgot to ask their name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have told them about the shipment but received only the address and have not confirmed their name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な記入事項をご案内します。相手の方に確認できるなら、先にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll explain the required details. If you can check with them, please ask them first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。今メッセージを送ります。住所の画面に出ているアカウント名を、そのまま受取人名にしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: アカウント名を流用せず本人へ氏名確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll message them now. I won't simply use the account name shown on the address screen as the recipient's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask them to confirm their name instead of reusing their account name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認してから記入されてください。荷物はまだ預けなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please fill it out after checking. You don't need to hand over the parcel yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。返事が来るまで待ちたいのですが、ほかのお客さんの邪魔にならない所へ移ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信待ちで記入台を空ける場所への移動を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'd like to wait for their reply. May I move somewhere where I won't get in other customers' way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to move away and free up the writing counter while waiting for a reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入台から離れて、お待ちいただけます。準備ができてから窓口へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may wait away from the writing counter. Please come to the service counter once you're ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。名前の書き方も本人に聞き、宛先全体を見直してから持ってきます。返事がなければ今日は持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名表記と宛先を確認し未返信なら持ち帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll also ask them how to write their name and check the entire address before bringing it back. If they don't reply, I'll take it home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the spelling of the name and the address, and take the parcel home if there is no reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、確認ができましたらお越しください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come back when you've confirmed it. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの説明をご確認いただけますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 文字が小さくて読みづらいです。内容を自分で確かめてから話したいので、読みやすくする方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行資料の小字を自分で確認するため読取補助を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The print is small and hard to read. I'd like to check the content myself before discussing it. Is there a way to make it easier to read?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for reading assistance so you can check the small print in bank materials yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご覧になりやすい資料や、ご説明の方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check for easier-to-read materials or another way to explain them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。全部を代わりに決めてもらいたいのではなく、まず項目の名前を読めるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 判断代行ではなく項目名を読める状態を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I don't want someone to make all the decisions for me; first, I want to be able to read the item names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to be able to read the item names, rather than have someone decide for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つずつ項目をご説明することもできます。どこから確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can also explain the items one by one. Where shall we start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この表の左側からお願いします。行を見失うので、今説明している場所を指していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表左側から説明し現在の行を指してほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please start on the left side of this table. I lose track of the rows, so it would help if you pointed to the part you're explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation from the left side of the table and for the current row to be pointed out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を示しながら説明します。書き込む部分は、内容を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll point out each part as I explain. I'll guide you through the parts to fill in after we've checked their content.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。まだ記入していません。数字が似て見える所は、自分でも読み上げて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未記入で似た数字は自分でも復唱確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I haven't filled anything in yet. Where numbers look alike, I'd like to read them aloud myself to check them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have not filled it in and want to repeat similar-looking numbers yourself to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方法で一緒に確認しましょう。読みづらい所はその都度お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check together that way. Please tell me whenever a part is hard to read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。急いで印を付けず、項目と自分の希望が合っているか聞いてから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 項目と希望を確認してから記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I won't rush to mark anything; I'll ask whether the items match my wishes before filling it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the items against your wishes before filling it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、最初の項目からご説明します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain the first item now. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 試食はいかがでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: How did you like the sample?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: おいしかったです。この味を買いたいのですが、ここに置いてある袋を取ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食した味を購入したく実演袋が購入対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was delicious. I'd like to buy this flavor. Should I take the bag placed here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the demonstration bag is the item to buy, since you want the flavor you sampled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは実演で使っている袋です。販売用の未開封の商品をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the bag we're using for the demonstration. I'll show you an unopened product for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。味の名前を見ていなかったので、似た袋から選ぶ前に教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 味名未確認で類似包装から選ぶ前に表示案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I didn't look at the flavor name, so please tell me before I choose from similar bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to be shown the label before choosing among similar packages because you have not checked the flavor name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の表示で、この味を確認できます。ご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can identify this flavor from the label on the bag. Would you like to look?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。赤い袋だけ覚えていましたが、別の味にも赤が使われていますね。味の名前を読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 赤色包装だけでなく味の名称を読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I only remembered the red bag, but other flavors use red too. I'd like to read the flavor name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will read the flavor name instead of relying only on the red packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示はこちらです。内容量も種類によって違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the label. The amounts also differ by product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人で食べるので、小さい袋を探しています。同じ味で量の少ない物があるか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人用の同じ味の小容量商品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll be eating it alone, so I'm looking for a small bag. I'd like to see whether there's a smaller quantity of the same flavor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a small quantity of the same flavor for one person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 販売棚の種類を確認しましょう。実演の場所とは別に並んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the varieties on the sales shelf. They are displayed separately from the demonstration area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。実演用の袋はここへ置いたまま、販売棚で味と量を見て選びます。試食させてくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実演袋を残し販売棚で味と量を確認して選ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll leave the demonstration bag here and choose from the sales shelf after checking the flavor and amount. Thank you for letting me try it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the demonstration bag and choose from the sales shelf after checking flavor and quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、販売棚をご案内します。お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. I'll show you the sales shelf. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園の案内窓口です。ご用件をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the park information desk. How can I help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日の午後に公園へ行き、子どもの上着を忘れたようです。家に帰ってから気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰宅後に子供上着の置き忘れへ気づいたと電話する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: We went to the park this afternoon, and I think we left my child's jacket there. I noticed after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Call to say you noticed your child's jacket was left behind after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember where you last saw it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 遊具の近くのベンチです。青い上着で、内側のタグに名前を書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遊具付近ベンチと青色とタグ記名を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: On a bench near the playground equipment. It's a blue jacket, with a name written on the inside tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the bench near the playground, blue color, and name on the tag as details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お問い合わせの内容を確認します。今すぐこちらへ向かう予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the details of your inquiry. Are you planning to head here right away?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車で戻ろうとしていましたが、見つかっているか分からないので、先に電話しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発見不明なので車で戻る前に問い合わせたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was going to drive back, but I don't know whether it's been found, so I called first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you called before driving back because you do not know whether it has been found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲を調べます。見つかった場合に連絡できる番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll look into what we can check. Please give me a number where we can contact you if it's found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今かけている番号です。子どもは家にいます。上着の写真もありますが、必要なら送り方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現電話番号を連絡先とし写真は必要時に方法を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number I'm calling from now. My child is at home. I also have a photo of the jacket; if you need it, please tell me how to send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your current phone number as the contact and say you will ask how to send the photo if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず特徴と連絡先を伺います。確認後に、受け取りなどの方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: First, I'll take the description and your contact details. After checking, we'll explain how to collect it and any other arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。見つかったと連絡をもらってから受け取りを相談します。まだ見つかっていない段階で子どもに戻ったとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見連絡後に受取相談し子供へ未発見を正確に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll discuss collection after you contact me to say it's been found. I won't tell my child it's back while it hasn't been found yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss collection after notification and accurately tell your child it has not yet been found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、確認いたします。お電話ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨が強くなりましたね。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The rain has become heavy. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傘から水が落ちています。電車で座る時に置き方が気になるので、乗る前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 滴る長傘の車内での置き方を乗車前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Water is dripping from my umbrella. I'm concerned about where to put it when I sit on the train, so I'd like to ask before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before boarding how to place a dripping full-length umbrella on the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの傘は、折り畳めない長い傘ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your umbrella is a long one that doesn't fold, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。隣の席へ横に置こうと思いましたが、水も付くし、ほかの人が座れなくなりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 横置きでは他客の席をふさぎ濡らすと気づきを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought of laying it across the next seat, but that would wet it and stop someone else from sitting there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you realize laying it sideways would wet and block another passenger's seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周りの方や通路に気をつけて、ご自身の荷物としてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep it with you as your own luggage, taking care of people nearby and the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に傘を閉じます。ホームで強く振って水を飛ばすのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傘を閉じホームで水を振り飛ばさないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll close it first. I won't shake it hard on the platform and send water flying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will close the umbrella and not shake water off it on the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋やカバーはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a bag or cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カバーがあります。急いでいて使っていませんでした。端まで入れてから持とうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所持カバーを使い先端まで入れて持つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a cover. I was in a hurry and hadn't used it. I'll put it in all the way to the tip before carrying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use the cover you have and insert the umbrella all the way to the tip before carrying it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗る時も、傘の先がほかの方に当たらないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When boarding too, please make sure the umbrella tip doesn't hit anyone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。かばんとまとめて手元に持ちます。降りる時にも傘があるか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手元保管と降車時の所持確認をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll hold it together with my bag, close to me. I'll also check that I have it when getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep it close at hand and check you have it when leaving the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、足元に気をつけてご乗車ください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch your step as you board. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 施設のご予約についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a facility reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。読書会で部屋を予約しましたが、参加者と相談して、布を使った工作もしたくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読書用予約に布工作を追加したく変更相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I reserved a room for a reading group, but after discussing it with participants, we'd also like to do crafts using fabric.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about changing a reading reservation to add fabric crafts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更後に、どのような道具を使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What tools do you plan to use after the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はさみと布用ののりです。机にのりが付くかもしれないので、読書だけの予約のままでよいか気になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: はさみと布のりと机の汚れ可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Scissors and fabric glue. Since glue might get on the tables, I wondered whether keeping the reservation as reading only would be acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain about scissors, fabric glue, and the possibility of dirtying the tables. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用内容の変更として、施設の担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with the facility staff about changing the activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。片づければよいと自分で決めず、道具と作業を先に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 清掃だけで可と判断せず道具作業の事前確認を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't decide for myself that cleaning up makes it acceptable; I'll explain the tools and work in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Promise to check the tools and activities beforehand instead of assuming cleanup alone makes them acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当初の予約内容を確認できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have something showing the original reservation details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この控えです。人数と時間は同じですが、活動が変わったことを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約控えを示し人数時間は同じで活動変更と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is my copy. The number of people and the time are the same, but I'd like to explain that the activity has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the reservation copy and say the number and time are unchanged but the activity is changing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当で、部屋の条件や必要な準備をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss the room conditions and necessary preparations with the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。参加者にはまだ道具を持ってくるよう頼んでいません。利用できる内容を確認してから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具持参依頼は施設条件確認後にすると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I haven't yet asked participants to bring tools. I'll contact them after checking which activities are permitted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask participants to bring tools only after checking the facility's conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、施設の担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the facility staff. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの準備について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about preparing to go home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母の付き添いで来ました。帰りは兄の車ですが、兄はまだ仕事中です。会計が終わったら私から連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母の受診付き添いで仕事中の兄へ会計後に迎え連絡したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came to accompany my mother. My older brother will drive us home, but he's still at work. I'd like to contact him myself after payment is finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are accompanying your mother to her appointment and want to ask your brother, who is working, to collect you after payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今のお付き添いは、あなたお一人ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You're the only one accompanying her now, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。兄に病院から直接電話が行くと思っていましたが、まず私が迎えの時間を相談するつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分のみ同行し病院直連絡でなく自分が時間相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought the hospital would call my brother directly, but I intend to discuss the pickup time with him myself first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are the only companion and will discuss the time yourself instead of relying on a direct hospital call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お迎えの連絡はご家族で確認されてください。待つ場所についてご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please arrange pickup contact within your family. We can show you where to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。母が休める所で待ちたいです。車が着く前から外に出て立っているのは難しいと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母が休める待機所を希望し屋外立位は難しいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'd like to wait somewhere my mother can rest. I think standing outside before the car arrives would be difficult for her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a waiting place where your mother can rest and explain that standing outside is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる待機場所と、お迎えの時の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the available waiting areas and pickup instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。兄には駐車の案内も伝えたいので、分かった内容をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 兄へ伝える当日駐車案内をメモしたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'd like to tell my brother the parking instructions too, so I'll note down what I find out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to note down that day's parking instructions to pass to your brother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 当日のご案内をご確認ください。お母様の具合が変わったら職員へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check today's instructions. If your mother's condition changes, tell a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。会計の後に兄へ電話し、到着の連絡を受けてから移動を相談します。母の様子も見ながら待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計後連絡し到着後移動を相談し母の状態も見ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll call my brother after payment and discuss moving once he tells me he's arrived. I'll keep an eye on my mother while we wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will call after payment, discuss moving after arrival, and monitor your mother's condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、待機場所をご案内します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you the waiting area. Please take care on your way home.
